instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level medium full shot. Inside a boxing gym with stacked red and black mats in the background, the woman in the blue jacket (R2) stands barefoot on the right, wearing pink boxing gloves and throwing a punch. On the left, the man in the gray t-shirt (R1) stands with his back partially turned, holding up black boxing mitts to catch her punch. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the black mat floor, and a whiteboard is visible on the wall behind them.
